title: How AI‑powered policing is endangering the public's trust in police
description: Since the release of ChatGPT in 2022, artificial intelligence (AI) has dominated the cultural landscape. Uptake across various sectors, including law enforcement, quickly followed, usually with minimal foresight and little to no guardrails, like effective policies or laws, to govern AI use.

title: Designer Creates Shirt Meant to Confuse AI Surveillance Cameras

The garment – which features a clashing arrangement of pink, orange and green shapes – is designed to exploit vulnerabilities in how machine vision algorithms recognize human figures.
